sources.entry: TeslaMate - A powerful data logger for Tesla vehicles. MIT Elixir/Docker
TeslaMate | Data logger for your Tesla

summary.one_liner: TeslaMate is a self-hosted data logger that records Tesla vehicle data into Postgres, with Grafana dashboards for visualization and MQTT publishing.
summary.what_it_does: TeslaMate is a self-hosted logger for Tesla vehicles, written in Elixir. It stores recorded data in a Postgres database and provides Grafana for visualization and analysis. Vehicle data is also published to a local MQTT broker, which can feed tools like Home Assistant, Node-RED and Telegram. The README lists features including high-precision drive recording, automatic address lookup, geo-fencing for custom locations, charge cost tracking, and support for multiple vehicles per Tesla account. It bundles about 20 Grafana dashboards covering battery health, charging, drives, efficiency, vampire drain, mileage and lifetime driving maps. It can import data from TeslaFi and tesla-apiscraper, and its web interface is available in 19 languages.
use_cases: log every drive and charge session from my Tesla
track battery health and range degradation over time
analyze energy consumption and efficiency of an EV
feed Tesla data into Home Assistant or Node-RED via MQTT
measure vampire drain while the car is parked
migrate history from TeslaFi or tesla-apiscraper
how_to_run: See the official documentation (linked from the README, not included in the README text itself) for installation and setup.
notable: Bundled Grafana dashboards for battery health, charging, drives, efficiency, and vampire drain
Publishes vehicle data to a local MQTT broker for home automation integrations
Imports history from TeslaFi and tesla-apiscraper
Car is allowed to fall asleep as soon as possible to limit vampire drain
caveats: The README warns that unofficial forks, websites and mobile apps using the TeslaMate name may be harmful; only use the official source.
